editorial_notes: Fifty-five complete foreign essays independently authored from all eleven Chinese originals and corrected Chinese, with substantive arguments and examples retained; no translation service.
Seventy-seven manuscripts in seven authored languages, with offline Traditional Chinese; section counts 7/8/7/7/8/7/8/8/7/8/9.
Author self-review and independent full cross-review completed before freezing; manual corrections are not replaced by word-count checks.
Classical source panels, source-paper site, stable URLs, intro and previous receipts remain unchanged. Eight original DOI destinations for 71–72, nine for 73–81.
Titles, indexes, metadata, navigation through the final chapter, dictionaries, search and sitemap synchronized.

Ch71: Confidence is not a diagnostic of ignorance, caution not proof of expertise. Dunning–Kruger: original task-specific research on overestimating performance; avoid universal inverse-confidence curve or calling people idiots, no claim philosophy anticipates scientific result. Received 不知知 can mean unrecognized ignorance, not necessarily conscious pretending. 病 is fault/affliction metaphor, not exclusion of ordinary illness; first病 in病病 commonly regard fault as fault/be troubled by it, not literally 'see clearly'. Knowing limits reduces avoidable error, not immunity. Socrates familiar 'I know nothing' slogan is a paraphrase; attribute to Plato Apology21d, not exact quote; no secure simultaneous Laozi/Socrates dates, cultural independence proof or truth proved by two thinkers agreeing. Preserve analogy, explicitly different contexts. Learned expertise can be confident with stated grounds; check reasons, not modest mannerisms.

Ch72: Fear can persist; no universal depletion clock or promised backlash. 大威 has interpretive range. 狎 light treatment and intrusion/oppression readings coexist. 厌 oppression/weariness/satiety readings must be acknowledged: 'do not decide they already have enough' is the series' modern extension, not established exclusive translation of 毋厌其所生/夫唯弗厌. Not endlessly optimizing others or refusing their own contentment. Self-love permits saying no, fair pay and public explanation; visible self-confidence needn't conceal insecurity. 去彼取此 can require practice and restraint; insight doesn't automatically erase habits or eliminate effort. Grouping is modern editorial, not ancient composition; preview81 adopted 人之道, not 圣人之道.

Ch73: 敢 contextual boldness/daring, not provably neutral everywhere. 杀/活 grave contrast not statistical rule. 孰知其故 retains uncertainty, not certain rhetorical question with scientifically known answer. 天 can have multiple ancient meanings; naturalistic reading is this essay's choice, not proof no religious register. 善应 primarily respond aptly, not secure response from others; dialogue application okay. 繟然而善谋 is NOT 不谋: three不 plus a calm-planning clause; do not invent fourth不. Adopted不战 vs received不争 not proof deliberate dilution. Not initiating doesn't guarantee being left alone; defensive/protective action valid. Net is moral/cosmological image, not a causal theorem promising every harm punished/every effort repaid. Consequences may spread or remain unseen, victims can bear them; unseen good worth need not rest on future reward.

Ch74: 恒且 not lexical proof people were already made chronically fearless. 不畏死 doesn't mean anyone under hardship inevitably fearless; threats can still harm. 司杀者 has natural/heavenly/death-order and human-office readings; modern judicial independence analogy must be explicitly limited, not ancient institutional proof or endorsement of executions. Separate expertise from authority and legitimacy: lawful procedure, scrutiny, protection, appeal matter; office or skill doesn't license killing. 畸/奇 doesn't prove deeds vs permanent identity, retain distinction as ethical application. Substitution risk falls on others as well as decision-maker; no guaranteed payback. Rare substitute injury doesn't logically prove master injury. Tacit skills learnable through practice, not irretrievably unteachable. Delegation not no oversight; intervene for safety/abuse appropriately. Ending75 honors revised political reading rather than returning to 'don't value your own life'.

Ch75: Received 难治 ALSO explicitly blames rulers'有为: do not claim grammatical subject/blame reversed by that variant or intentional corruption. WangBi even says 皆由上不由其下. Third clause subject varies across editions; 求生之厚 can include rulers' lavish pursuit of life or intense pursuit/preservation of life, while burden-of-subsistence is adopted social reading, not exclusive厚 definition. 有以为 doesn't inherently mean dishonest pretext; legitimate purposes can still obscure costs, but not every intervention/opportunity is colonization. 无以生为 political application explicit, not categorical claim every grammatical subject is ruler. Don't diagnose disengagement from one cause; poverty can constrain without abolishing hope/care/fear. Institutions/actions/support can improve conditions; noninterference not abandonment or refusal of aid/regulation.76 transition quote must match frozen panel (no 筋肕).

Ch76: Replace headline/universal 'all living things soft' and false 'hard wood blocks all water and dies'. Living trees have hard supporting/conducting tissue; hardness isn't death and rigidity of disabled/aging bodies isn't moral failure. Corpse/plant comparison is selected image not biological classification. 梗 has interpretive/variant uncertainty, not settled vascular blockage or original right versus折wrong. Bamboo can break and large trees survive storms; outcomes depend on conditions, bending not immunity and victims not to blame. Strong army doesn't always lose; arrogance/inflexibility warning. 柔弱微细 is responsiveness/growth image, not worth depends on continual productivity. Boundaries/stable safeguards can be needed. ‘强大居下’ leadership application, not universal physics/architecture theorem or only strong people can care.

Ch77: Natural equalization examples are bounded analogies, not universal cosmic redistribution; nature also concentrates and destroys, no reassurance time makes everyone equal. Bow illustration not precision archery manual. 人之道 tendency under conditions, not immutable human nature/no wrongdoing ever; avoid asserting Laozi's tone provably neutral or he calls it自然. 有余奉于天=emulation is commentary; 奉天下 not necessarily condescending charity. Material redistribution, rules and institutional action remain important; don't reduce unequal resources to personal ego. Title must not tell deprived readers they necessarily have surplus self to cut. Credit, wages, visibility and rights may be deserved; relinquish monopoly over credit, not authorship or dignity. Giving resources can really help, no gift-as-domination generalization.

Ch78: Water not literally invulnerable or uniquely able to erode; 无以易之 commonly replace but no exclusion of all other glosses. Steel cutting typically abrasive waterjet with machinery/pressure, not plain softness or patience proving doctrine. Knowledge/action gap more than weak will: skills/support/constraints matter. 受 does not lexically prove voluntary choice; assumption of responsibility mustn't mean scapegoating, hiding wrongdoing, forced unpaid emotional labor or unsafe self-sacrifice. Need truthful reporting, fair process, resources and repair; suffering doesn't confer legitimacy automatically. 邦/国 name-taboo explanation is important but practices vary; Mawangdui copies also show historical layers, not unaltered autograph. 正言若反 not inverse truth test or proof all water/leadership outcomes certain.

Ch79: ‘必有余怨’ emphasizes limits of settlement; don't declare every conflict permanently unhealable or justice useless. ‘必有余怨’ is4characters, not3. Right/left contract readings and介/契 relations have serious basis; author's崇尚调停 philosophical reading not a proven dictionary restoration. Remove erroneous 右丞相李斯 evidence (official title doesn't proveverbfavor). 彻 can relate fields AND levy/tax tradition; 公刘彻田为粮 doesn't exclude tax sense here. 无德=not-yet-trained is constructive application not obligatory literal meaning; agricultural work not morally lower or needsnoethicaljudgment. No mandatory career hierarchy/no person assigned labor by moralworth. Systems review coexists with proportionate accountability, justice and safety; no perfect process that never fails. Mediators consent/competence/limits, not swallowing all abuse or forcing victim reunion. Prevention doesn't justify prying/control. 天道 moral/philosophical hope not empirical guarantee or universal reward; worth not contingent on contribution.

Ch80: No 'misread for2000yrs' or all dictionary controversy solved. 什佰 military grouping plausible interpretive route, not sole sense; boats/carts civilian too. Smallness doesn't protect from conquest. 重身=pregnant doesn't establish重死=natural reproduction/death; explicitly remove unsupported lexical derivation, common重死=take death seriously. Preserve author's antiwar wish of generations living/aging safely as application, not gloss. Adopted远徙 versus received不远徙: discuss distinction without universalclaimall silkcopies identical; escaping war is application, not ensured ability. Neither refuge nor staying must be forced; real exit often constrained. 结绳archaic ideal/paternalistic使民cannot simply be translated out; useful records/literacy/services needed, not all complexity causedbywar. Genuine deprivation/discrimination matter, not all dissatisfactioncomparison; enjoyfoodwithoutrenouncingbetterconditions. 不相往来literally limitedcontactnotonlynoninterference, modern supportive-neighbor reading explicit; mutualaid/voluntarycontact valid.

Ch81: Received order makes81closehere; silkorder differs, no claim author's lastwrittenwords or proven singulararchitecturalintent. Threecontrasts-example-conclusionisourreadingnotexclusiveancientlogic. 美canbeautiful/ornate/flattering; unpleasant≠true, kindeloquenttruthpossible. 知notlexicallyonlyselfbelievedknowledge; standarddepth/breadthreadsacknowledged beforeauthorclosureofjudgmentapplication. 善/多otherlexicalusagesdon'tproveonlyskill/overvaluing here; received善辩notnecessarilyunrelated. 既commonlyalready/fully/after, notliteralfor-example;illustrationsremaininterpretive. Generositycanenrichunderstanding/relationsbutnoinevitablereturn;finitecapacity/boundaries/payvalid. 天利不害ideal not natureempiricallyharmless;sun/raincanhurt. 人之道invitesordinaryreadersbut圣人idealcanalsobeaspirationalnotexclusivecaste; 不争doesn'tforbidjustclaims/protection. Endwithactionandpractice,notanti-self/identitydenial or claimmemoryaloneequalsexcellence.
